notes: Fixed candidate grid declared before this run's outer-test scoring. All choices and thresholds use grouped inner OOF predictions from outer training rows only.
All five seeds' choices are frozen before any new test score is computed. The outer development splits have already been inspected in previous experiments; this is not an untouched final evaluation.
No requirement or assertion forces the score to reach 0.8. Accuracy, pooled macro-F1 and official within-word macro-F1 remain separately named.
Training-only vocabulary, SVD, scaling, classifiers and calibration; no new pretrained model or encoder fine-tuning.
Metadata includes target word, POS and historical period, which were permitted baseline inputs. These may exploit domain priors; future-period and unseen-lemma generalization are not established.
Word-class sample weighting aligns the training loss more closely to the official equal-word objective, with clipped weights to limit rare-label influence.
Ensemble weights are fixed, component margin scales are fitted from training OOF outputs, and calibration uses training OOF labels only.
